The `__call__` method of the `OpenIdConnect` class reads the `Authorization` header from the request. If the `Authorization` header is not present and `auto_error` is set to `True`, it raises an `HTTPException` with a 403 status code and the detail "Not authenticated". Otherwise, it returns the `Authorization` header directly.
